'''Callista Ming's lightsaber''' was a single-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] created by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Altisian Jedi]], Callista Ming. While the lightsaber was predominantly used by Callista Ming, it briefly fell into the hands of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] known as Shorty and later [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Luke Skywalker when Callista had [[Essence transfer|transferred her consciousness]] into the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''. Callista, however, reclaimed ownership of her lightsaber after she was freed from the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaught]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].
